=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:716,882 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The script mounts two different host files at the same sandbox path, `/relay.py`: `claude_anthropic_relay.py` at line 716 and `chatgpt_codex_relay.py` at line 882. The `/relay.py` registry entry in `tests/test_sandbox_python_coverage.py` lists only `claude_anthropic_relay.py`, so its basename check rejects the ChatGPT relay with `AssertionError: 'chatgpt_codex_relay.py' != 'claude_anthropic_relay.py'`.
  WHY: The reviewer rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high. It turns six checks red on head da9b888: tests-sandbox-python for clarify, review and codex-isolated-codex, tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, tests-system-python (11), and lint. The failure also exists on the merge base, and issue #9449 forbids changing any script, so the fix belongs on the base branch: give the ChatGPT relay its own mount path, or let the `/relay.py` registry entry accept both basenames. The editor should not change anything in this PR for it. minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash named the same cause in their notes but did not report it as a finding, because it is inherited and out of scope.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:716,882 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Line 716 is `--mount "type=bind,src=$(realpath "${support}/claude_anthropic_relay.py"),dst=/relay.py,readonly"` and line 882 is `--mount "type=bind,src=$(realpath "${support}/chatgpt_codex_relay.py"),dst=/relay.py,readonly"`. Two different host files share the `/relay.py` entry point, but the registry in `tests/test_sandbox_python_coverage.py` lists only `claude_anthropic_relay.py` for it. The check `assertEqual(basename, Path(entry["host"]).name)` at line 293 (taken from the CI traceback) therefore rejects the ChatGPT relay.
  WHY: Every CI job that runs the coverage test fails with `AssertionError: 'chatgpt_codex_relay.py' != 'claude_anthropic_relay.py'`. Six checks on head da9b888 are red. The failure also exists on the merge base, and issue #9449 forbids changing scripts, so the fix belongs on the base branch: a separate mount path, or a registry entry that accepts both basenames. It is reported only because the CI rules require every failed check to be surfaced; the editor should not change anything in this PR for it.
